Data Narration

Data Storytelling System

This system helps data teams tell the story of their data by: 1. Watching for new chapters in the data’s journey 2. Crafting beautiful narratives about data changes 3. Keeping a living history of the data’s evolution 4. Sharing these stories with the whole team

Key Features: - Automatic story detection when data changes - Engaging, human-readable narratives - A complete chronicle of data’s journey - Beautiful documentation of the adventure

Example Usage:

```python import pandas as pd

# Every data read tells a story df = pd.read_csv(‘my_data.csv’)

# When the data changes, a new chapter unfolds df = pd.read_csv(‘my_data.csv’) # Will narrate any changes ```

Created by: Data Storytellers Guild Date: May 2025

data_narrator.tell_example_story()[source]

Demonstrate the art of data storytelling.

This tale shows: 1. The birth of a dataset 2. Its first reading 3. How it grows and changes 4. How we detect and share its evolution 5. How we document its journey

The data_narrator module provides functionality for generating human-readable reports about data changes:

  • Change reporting

  • Data summarization

  • Narrative generation

Example Usage

from data_narrator import DataNarrator

# Create a narrator instance
narrator = DataNarrator()

# Generate a report about changes
report = narrator.generate_report('data.csv')

# Print the report
print(report)
